name: tactical-rmm-mcp
description: Every Tactical RMM endpoint as a typed command, plus an offline SQLite mirror and cross-entity fleet queries the web UI can't express.

trmm_api_key.title: TRMM_API_KEY
trmm_api_key.description: Tactical RMM API key (Settings > Global Settings > API Keys). Bypasses 2FA.

tactical_rmm_base_url.title: Tactical RMM API base URL
tactical_rmm_base_url.description: Base URL of your Tactical RMM API host, e.g. https://api.rmm.example.com. It is the api.* hostname from your Tactical RMM install, not the web UI hostname. The shipped default points at an example host.

tactical_rmm_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
tactical_rmm_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

tactical_rmm_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
tactical_rmm_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.

tactical_rmm_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
tactical_rmm_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Tactical RMM requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

tactical_rmm_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
tactical_rmm_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
